title: Godot 4.4 Steam crashes when reimporting texture
body:
### Tested versions

-Tested on v4.4.stable.steam [4c311cbee]

### System information

Windows 10 - v4.4.stable.steam [4c311cbee] - Mobile rendering pipeline - Nvidia 1660 Super

### Issue description

The steam build of Godot reliably crashes on my PC when re-importing a texture, either manually or automatically when dropped into a material; this bug is not present when tested on non-steam Godot 4.4, it is exclusive to the steam version. I have wiped all cache files I could find, and the issue remains. Traceback below, though it didn't give a proper trace;




res://Models/Apple Shading Practice.png: Texture detected as used in 3D. Enabling mipmap generation and setting the texture compression mode to VRAM Compressed (S3TC/ETC/BPTC).

--------------------------------


```
CrashHandlerException: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.4.stable.steam (4c311cbee68c0b66ff8ebb8b0defdd9979dd2a41)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug to the project developer.
[1] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
[2] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
[3] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
............
[29] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
[30] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
[31] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
-- END OF BACKTRACE --
```


### Steps to reproduce

New or existing project, opening texture import settings for a file, clicking reimport; even if no settings are changed, it crashes the program.
